column1: # How Kokoro should say words it gets wrong (scripts/voice/README.md, "Fixing a word").
# One word a line: the word, a tab, then either
#   phonemes between slashes, as `kokoro_voice.py try` prints them   e.g.  phenotype<TAB>/fˈinətˌIp/
#   or a respelling that Kokoro says right                         e.g.  pseudopodia<TAB>sue doe poe dee uh
# Whole words only, any capitalization. The recordings' names do not change, so after adding a word, record the
# questions that use it again:  python scripts/voice/kokoro_voice.py generate --force --only-with <word>
